parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Ruchika Watts, aged about 26 years, R/o House No. 6, Ward No. 13, Srikaranpur, District Sri Ganganagar — Petitioner
parties.respondent_defendant: State of Rajasthan Through the Secretary, Primary Education, Government of Rajasthan, Jaipur; The Director, Primary Education, Bikaner; Zila Parishad, Sri Ganganagar Through Chief Executive Officer — Respondents

facts_of_case: Petitioner had submitted her form on 20.08.2013 for appointment on the post of Teacher Grade-III, whereas her marriage stood dissolved on 18.12.2015. She claims that since she was granted decree of divorce before finalisation of the Select List, her candidature should be considered as a 'Divorcee'.

legal_principles.principle: A person cannot be treated as a divorcee until a decree of divorce has been issued.
legal_principles.held: As per Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act, a marriage shall stand dissolved only with effect from the date of decree. It will not be out of place to reproduce sub-section (2) of Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act, which reads thus :-

legal_principles.principle: The incidence of divorce or status of divorcee is attained on the dissolution of marriage.
legal_principles.held: A person would continue to belong to a particular caste or class, notwithstanding a caste certificate, but a person cannot be called a divorcee, unless a decree of divorce has been issued.

legal_principles.principle: The matrimony comes to an end only on the issuance of a decree of divorce and till then, husband and wife continue to remain in the wedlock.
legal_principles.held: The matrimony comes to an end only on the issuance of a decree of divorce and till then, husband and wife continues to remain in the wedlock, despite all the differences and disputes.

legal_principles.principle: A person cannot be called a divorcee, unless a decree of divorce has been issued.
legal_principles.held: A person cannot be called a divorcee, unless a decree of divorce has been issued.

outcome.final_order: The respondents may kindly be directed to consider the case of the petitioner under the general woman divorced category candidate in Teacher Grade III Recruitment 2013 for Level-I and consequently after considering the case of the petitioner as general woman divorced category candidate, the petitioner may be given appointment on the post of Teacher Grade III Level-I as per her merit with all consequential benefits.
